The CLI reads the evidence file and computes its SHA-256 itself; the operator never types a hash. Calls IssueCertificate and writes the sealed certificate to --cert-out (default gm-certificate.json in the current directory). status Call CertificateStatus and print the lifecycle state and body. verify Load a certificate file and call VerifyProof. revoke Call RevokeCertificate with a reason. Certificate RPCs need no session and no handshake. OUTPUT: issue {"issued": true, "serial": ..., "fingerprint": ..., "product": ..., "version": ..., "verdict": ..., "evidence_hash": ..., "cert_file": ...}; on refusal {"issued": false, "reason": ...}. status {"serial": ..., "status": "UNKNOWN|ACTIVE|SUPERSEDED|REVOKED", "body": ...} verify {"valid": , "reason": ...} revoke {"revoked": , "message": ..., "serial": ...} EXIT CODES: 0 issue: certificate issued; status: the daemon answered (UNKNOWN included); verify: proof valid; revoke: revoked. 1 issue: refused (for example a BLOCKED verdict); verify: proof invalid; revoke: the daemon answered revoked=false. 2 usage, evidence-file, certificate-file, transport or gRPC error.
